title: Serving DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at scale: vLLM matches DeepInfer
gist: With the model vendor's kernels integrated, upstream vLLM came close to the vendor's own bespoke engine on decode, then scaled out with prefill/decode disaggregation and wide expert parallelism.
changes: The best evidence that the commons keeps pace: the general engine landed within a few percent of one built by the model's own authors for that single model.
caveats: The vendor's figures were read off charts and its hardware is unstated. Prefill setups differ. The vendor's engine was itself originally built on vLLM.

numbers.metric: Decode against the model vendor's own engine

bears_on.note: A general open engine within 6% of a single-model bespoke one.
If a bespoke engine for one model buys 6%, per-customer builds have little room.
This parity came from people integrating the vendor's kernels by hand, quickly. Churn was absorbed without an agent loop.
